entry.title: New: dsh-bloom-theme
entry.summary: Bloom Morandi theme: four variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all eight foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better. Exact install spec: @kubor/dsh-bloom-theme. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
